name: auth-policy
obligations: All joins, issuance/revoke, policy reads and auth caches
exclusions: External identity directories and business policy remain outside core.

name: shared
existing: shared user tenant surrogate, key principal surrogate
target: explicit compatibility mapping; no local shared transaction dependency
exclusions: Local authority does not depend on shared transactions.

name: eval
target: tenant predicates and creator principal provenance
obligations: Subject/results/snapshot queries; no unscoped private aggregation
exclusions: Legacy unscoped operator readers must not become tenant readers.

name: evolution
obligations: Worker restore, publication, checkpoints, cache invalidation
exclusions: No second scheduler; existing owner worker is adapted.

name: sessions
obligations: Parent/child wake, restore, admission; harness keeps full transcript authority

name: trajectory
obligations: Background capture/cleanup, hash lookup, reward and evaluation joins
exclusions: No public raw-evidence export or cross-tenant aggregation.

name: continuation
target: preserve originating backend and principal; add explicit tenant
exclusions: No continuation transfer by hash substitution.

name: execution-metering
obligations: Recorder/finalizer/disconnect paths; ordinary metering is not strict commit
exclusions: Ordinary accounting is not strict receipt durability.

name: control-config
target: preserve operator boundary, add independent tenant resource commands
obligations: Operation IDs, active snapshot caches, config validation and reload
exclusions: Host-global reload and secret-bearing host configuration remain installation-operator-only.

name: credentials-routing
existing: Selected canonical credential-file path + provider/account; snapshot map and process-local ACCOUNTS leases/pending refresh replacements; default file may be outside state directory
target: Existing host-global slots stay explicit installation-operator pools unless an evidenced offline mapping creates a distinct tenant-owned slot
obligations: Inventory actual selected credential-store paths, all writers and pending refreshes. Fence every writer of each selected path, not just state-directory owners; backend has no cross-process exclusion. Drain or quarantine pending replacements before cutover. Rebuild private caches/leases with tenant, slot and authority revision; never export secrets.
exclusions: No tenant ownership inferred from a state directory or provider/account label.
